scope: Source and synthetic fixture preparation for Linux x86_64/aarch64 combined offline Python+inference+GGUF ZIP; not an actual binary/model deployment

observations.change: Explicit local llama-server --alias local matches default Studio model_id; OSError in inference binary spawn or local log open leaves offline UI usable; process/log state clear after shutdown

negative_cases: embedded control chars in archive filename

observations.status: submitted; independently evaluate results before treating as accepted

invariants: Asset inputs only from explicitly specified local files: no remote download, no implicit personal workspace copy, no installation.
Byte-specific SHA256 pins for Python executable, llama ELF and GGUF; fixed little-endian ELF64 x86_64/aarch64, GGUF magic, exclusive local model alias.
Two independent ZIP allowlists preserve original Studio base manifest and verify all additional runtime/model/license files.
Reject symlink escapes, unknown ZIP members, encrypted/special files, oversized data, permission widening to world writable, malformed paths and mismatched digests.
Reproducible ZIP on one source/toolchain is not signature, proof of authenticity, license clearance or runtime compatibility.
Native self-contained AI package has not been built/tested with actual Qwen weights and Python distribution, so no production release claim.
